text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"I lost again...
Even though I swore I'd never lose again...!"

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Did I... take racing
too lightly, I wonder...?"
choice_data_list: There's meaning in taking on the challenge itself
There's no time to be feeling down.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...Yeah. If you don't race, you won't suffer any heartache,
but you won't ever taste the joy of victory either."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
It's because winning isn't easy that it's worth working hard for.
I can't go giving up over something like this!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, I'm feelin' a whole lot better now!
All right, startin' tomorrow I'm gonna run with everything I've got again!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"...Yer right about that. Whining about it
ain't gonna make me any faster."

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Enough of this gloomy talk,
as soon as we get back, we're hitting training!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'll work hard, keep workin' hard,
and next time I'll definitely win!
